record.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:10 — Identifying a credential only by userId and appSlug is ambiguous for supported multi-account app installs, so refresh can return a different account's token and execute operations against the wrong external account.

adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in refreshOAuthTokens.ts. Looking at the diff, the function takes appSlug and userId as parameters and sends them to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT. The endpoint receives only calcomUserId and appSlug to identify which credential to refresh. However, Cal.com supports multiple accounts per app per user (e.g., multiple Google Calendar accounts). The credential table has an 'id' field that uniquely identifies each credential, but this function doesn't pass it. When a user has multiple accounts for the same app, the external endpoint cannot distinguish which specific credential/account to refresh, potentially returning tokens for the wrong account. This is a correctness bug that could cause operations to execute against the wrong external account.
